purpose: Validate Compose topology, secret handling, non-root container intent and explicit external-integration limitations without starting Docker.

findings.message: Compose declares the expected database, migration, API and worker services.
Compose requires database/auth secrets from the environment and does not hard-code the PostgreSQL password.
Application image declares a non-root runtime user.
API and worker are explicitly configured for production mode.
Environment example uses explicit replacement placeholders.
Static deployment configuration was validated, but Docker/PostgreSQL were not started by this read-only campaign.
findings.recommendation: Run a separate deployment-environment qualification against real Docker/PostgreSQL before production release.
